info.title: Ollastack API
info.description:
Ollastack is a form backend for developers AND AI agents — plus agent mail (real inboxes your agents own).

**Agents:** Authorize an agent in the dashboard, then POST to `/api/submit/<endpointSlug>` with `Authorization: Bearer <your-token>`. Your agents submit cleanly while bots stay blocked. Submissions are tagged in the inbox with the agent's label so you can review or filter.

**Humans:** Use cookie-based auth via `/api/auth/login` for the dashboard, or issue personal API tokens for scripting.

tags.name: agent
tags.description: Endpoints designed for AI-agent workflows. Highlighted in MCP servers and agent SDKs.

tags.name: tokens
tags.description: Personal API tokens (issued by humans, used by humans or agents).

tags.name: mail
tags.description: Agent Mail — give an AI agent a real email identity it can send, receive, and reply from, with a spam-filtered inbox. Agent workflow: (1) GET /api/mailboxes/check-handle?handle=<h> to verify availability; (2) POST /api/mailboxes {name, mode:'agent', handle:<h>} to claim <h>@agent.ollastack.com; (3) POST .../send to email out as that identity; (4) GET .../wait to long-poll inbound (never returns spam); (5) POST .../messages/{id}/reply to thread. 'test' mode gives a disposable random inbox on test.ollastack.com (unfiltered) for CI. Scopes are split per module so a CI token can't read or send as your real identity: mail.test:read|write|send for disposable inboxes, mail.agent:read|write|send for agent identities (:send covers send+reply and is separate from :write). Never granted by default.

get.description: Reports the deployed build's identity — stamped at build time. Use it to confirm which commit is live (the runtime counterpart of /opt/formdev/.deploy-sha). No auth, no secrets.

post.summary: Submit a form — anonymous or as an authorized agent
post.description:
Accepts JSON or form-encoded payload. When called with a valid Bearer credential scoped to the form's owner, the submission is recognized as authorized agent traffic and the spam-detection layer designed for anonymous callers is skipped — your per-form and account-level limits still apply.

Anonymous submissions (no Bearer) go through the full anti-spam pipeline and must come from an allowed Origin if the form has `allowedOrigins` set.

403.description: Origin not allowed for this form

post.summary: Register a new user account

401.description: Account with this email already exists

post.summary: Log in with email + password (sets cookie)
Log out (clear session cookie)

parameters.name: projectId
parameters.description: Filter to forms filed under this project.

post.summary: Create a new form
post.description: If `schemaJson` is provided, the form is template-seeded with those fields. Agents typically call this to scaffold a form for the human owner.

post.summary: Clone an existing form
Regenerate the public endpoint slug (invalidates the old URL)

patch.summary: Define or replace a form's fields
patch.description: Replaces the form's entire field list. This is the ONLY way to set form fields after creation — PATCH /api/forms/{id} does not accept schemaJson. Send the complete desired field list; it is not a merge.

400.description: VALIDATION_ERROR — the field list failed schema validation.

404.description: NOT_FOUND — form does not exist or is not owned by the caller.

post.summary: AI triage of a submission (category, sentiment, summary, reply)
post.description: Runs AI lead enrichment on the submission and returns structured triage: category, sentiment, urgency, a one-line summary, extracted entities, and a suggested reply. On-demand (never on the submit hot path); the result is not stored. Returns 503 if AI enrichment is not enabled on this server.

labels.description: Optional closed set the category must be chosen from.

200.description: { submissionId, model, enrichment: { category, sentiment, urgency, summary, entities, suggestedReply } }

404.description: Form or submission not found / not owned

503.description: AI enrichment is not enabled on this server

patch.summary: Mark as read/spam, recover, set status, add tags
patch.description: Send exactly one action. `recover: true` un-flags a spam or ML-quarantined submission and re-sends the notification as a clean lead (idempotent — won't duplicate an already-delivered email).

get.summary: Download submissions as CSV / Excel / JSON
get.description: Returns a file attachment of non-spam submissions. csv and excel include id, created_at, every form field, and the geo columns (country/city/region/postal_code/latitude/longitude/timezone). excel is a real .xlsx workbook. json carries the same data plus the raw payload. Up to 50,000 rows.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Output format. xlsx is an alias of excel.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Only submissions on/after this ISO timestamp.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Only submissions on/before this ISO timestamp.

get.summary: Submission + spam timeseries for a form

post.summary: Create a workflow rule (when a submission matches X, do Y)
post.description: Runs best-effort AFTER a submission is stored. conditions: {field, op, value} (op: contains|not_contains|equals|not_equals|exists; field "_spam" = the spam flag), matched by matchType all|any. actions: {type:'add_tag', value} | {type:'set_status', value:'new'|'read'|'archived'} | {type:'webhook', event?} | {type:'notify_email', to, subject?} | {type:'slack', url}.

post.summary: Register a webhook
Register a phone number as an SMS test inbox
post.description: Inbound SMS to this number — relayed and HMAC-signed to /api/ingest/sms — lands in this inbox with extracted OTP codes.

get.summary: List received SMS (newest first, with extracted codes)

get.description: Blocks up to `timeout` seconds and returns { message } the moment an SMS lands, or { message: null } on timeout. The CI primitive.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: 1..55s (default 30)

post.summary: Get a presigned URL to upload a file directly to storage
post.description: Returns { uploadId, uploadUrl, storageKey, expiresAt }. The client PUTs the file straight to uploadUrl (bytes never transit this API), then calls the confirm endpoint. Validated against the form's upload config.

400.description: Validation error (uploads off, size/type not allowed)

503.description: Object storage is not enabled on this server

post.summary: Mark an upload complete after PUTting the file

get.summary: Get a short-lived presigned download URL

post.summary: Publish a custom event to the form's webhook endpoints
post.description: Deliver an arbitrary event + payload through the reliable webhook engine (HMAC-signed, auto-retried with backoff, replayable, logged) to every active endpoint on the form — or to a single webhookId. One immediate attempt is made per endpoint; failures fall into the retry queue. The body the subscriber receives is { event, formId, formName, publishedAt, data }, signed exactly like a submission event.

webhookId.description: Optional: deliver to just this endpoint instead of all active ones.

200.description: Per-endpoint delivery results: { event, deliveries: [{ id, webhookId, url, outcome }] }. outcome is success | rescheduled | abandoned.

400.description: Validation error (bad event/payload, or no active endpoint).

404.description: Form or webhookId not found / not owned.

patch.description: Enables or disables delivery without losing config. This is a TOGGLE only — to change a webhook's URL or events, delete it and re-create it. A body without a boolean `isActive` returns 400 (not 500).

get.summary: List delivery attempts for a webhook (newest first)

post.summary: Re-send a past delivery's exact payload as a fresh delivery
post.description: Creates a new delivery row with the original stored payload (the original is untouched), makes one immediate attempt, then falls into the retry queue on failure. Works on any past outcome.

get.summary: Cross-form inbox (caller's submissions across all forms)

parameters.name: formId
parameters.description: Filter to a single form.

parameters.name: include_spam
parameters.description: Include spam-flagged rows alongside clean ones.

parameters.name: onlySpam
parameters.description: Only hard-spam rows (hidden from the default inbox).

parameters.name: onlyQuarantine

get.summary: Cross-form visitor geography for the caller
get.description: Aggregates non-spam submission geo across all the caller's forms (scoped by forms.userId). Response data: { total, withGeo, byCountry: [{country,count}], byCity: [{city,country,count}] }.

get.summary: Verification status of the org's custom sender domain
get.description: Read-only. status: none | not_found | pending | verified. Does not provision — onboarding a new domain to the shared provider account is a gated operator step.

put.summary: Set the org's custom sender domain (paid)

get.summary: Caller's email deliverability feed + summary stats
get.description: Notifications, autoresponders, and tests sent on the caller's behalf, scoped to your account. Response data includes { data, pagination, stats: { total, sent, failed, pending } }.

post.summary: Send a deliverability test to the caller's own address
post.description: Self-only — the recipient is always the authenticated user's email (not a relay). The send is logged to your deliverability feed.

get.summary: Caller's activity audit trail (forms, submissions, settings)
get.description: Append-only history of the caller's own actions. Every entry carries the acting user — this never surfaces another tenant's events. New inbound submissions are NOT here (see /api/submissions).

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Exact action, e.g. submission.recovered

get.summary: List the caller's API tokens (without plaintext)

post.summary: Issue a new API token (plaintext returned once)

get.summary: Recent activity for an API token (audit log)
get.description: Most recent 50 audit rows. Every Bearer-authenticated API call writes one row (method, path, status, hashed IP, user-agent, timestamp). Used to investigate what an agent has been doing and to confirm a revoked token has truly stopped.

404.description: Token not found or not owned

get.summary: Get the org's SMTP config (password masked)
get.description: Returns null when no SMTP is configured. Password is never returned — re-enter on edit.

put.description: Password is encrypted with AES-256-GCM at rest. Submission notifications, autoresponders, and digests for this org's forms will route through this SMTP; failures transparently fall back to the platform sender.

post.summary: Test the org's SMTP connection
post.description: Opens a SMTP session and runs `verify()` (no mail is sent); the result updates the config's stored health status.

get.summary: Submission counts + recent activity for one form
Rejected submissions (rate-limit, captcha, origin, validation, spam)
get.description: Every attempt blocked before it reached `submissions` — so the form owner can see lost enquiries. Fields: reason, detail, ipHash, payload snapshot, createdAt.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Filter by mailbox kind: 'agent' (persistent business identity, spam-filtered) or 'test' (disposable CI inbox, never filtered). Omit for both.

parameters.name: projectId
parameters.description: Filter to mailboxes filed under this project.

401.description: Missing/invalid auth or token lacks mail.test:read / mail.agent:read.

post.summary: Create a mailbox (agent or test)
post.description: agent mode: pass `handle` to claim a chosen address (your agent's identity) on the agent domain — spam-filtered, persistent. test mode (default): a disposable random address for CI. Any `+tag` variant routes to the same mailbox. Mailbox count is plan-capped.

400.description: Validation error, plan cap reached, or module not configured.

401.description: Missing/invalid auth or token lacks mail.test:write / mail.agent:write.

get.description: Live availability for the chosen agent identity. Does NOT reserve. reason is one of taken | reserved | invalid | agent_mail_disabled.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Defaults to the platform agent domain.

address.description: The full address the handle would resolve to.

401.description: Missing/invalid auth or token lacks mail.test:read / mail.agent:read.

404.description: Not found (or not owned by the caller — never disclosed which).

400.description: Validation error (e.g. retentionDays above plan ceiling).

delete.description: Soft-delete. The slug is never reused; later mail for it lands in failures.

get.description: Newest first. Bodies are omitted in the list — GET a single message for content.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive match on subject / from / recipient.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Filter to received (inbound) or sent (outbound) messages.

parameters.name: received_after
parameters.description: ISO timestamp — only messages received after this instant.

parameters.name: spam
parameters.description: true = the Spam view (hard-spam only). Default hides hard spam from the normal list.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Per-run filter — matches the +<tag> subaddress in the recipient (slug+<tag>@). A CI run picks a unique tag to isolate its mail.

delete.summary: Clear inbox — bulk-delete + purge every message
delete.description: Soft-deletes AND PII-purges all messages in the mailbox. Built for disposable test inboxes between CI runs. Returns { cleared: <count> }.

post.summary: AI triage of a mail message (category, sentiment, summary, reply)
post.description: Runs AI enrichment on the message and stores the result on it. Body (optional): { labels?: string[] }. 503 if AI isn't enabled on the server.

503.description: AI enrichment not enabled on this server

get.description: Marks the message read.

delete.description: Soft-delete + PII purge (raw source, bodies, extracted codes/links).

get.description: Returns a short-lived presigned `downloadUrl` for the attachment at the 0-based `index` in the message's `attachments` array — fetch it directly for the bytes. 404 if the attachment has no stored content (metadata only, e.g. object storage was unconfigured when the message arrived, or it's an outbound message).

200.description: A presigned download URL + attachment metadata.

404.description: Attachment not found or has no stored content.

get.description: Blocks until a matching message arrives or `timeout` elapses. Returns `{message}` immediately when one lands, `{message: null}` on timeout (HTTP 200 either way — loop on null). Returns the OLDEST unseen message after `since`; advance `since` to the returned message's receivedAt and re-call to drain a burst in arrival order. Max 55s per call; for longer waits, re-call with the same `since`. Typical CI flow: create mailbox -> trigger the email in your app -> wait -> read `message.codes[0]`.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: Seconds to wait, 1-55. Default 30.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: ISO timestamp; only messages received after this. Defaults to request arrival.

parameters.name: to_contains
parameters.description: Match the envelope recipient — filter to one `+tag` variant.

400.description: Too many concurrent waits on this mailbox.

post.summary: Send an email FROM this mailbox
post.description: Agent mail: sends from the mailbox's own address via the platform's outbound provider. Stored as direction=outbound with deliveryStatus. Set `sendAt` (future ISO time) to SCHEDULE the send (reminders/follow-ups) — it's queued as deliveryStatus=scheduled and delivered by the drain; DELETE the message before then to cancel. Counts against this mailbox's monthly send quota (per-mailbox, separate from the received quota; a scheduled send reserves quota at schedule time). Requires the dedicated send scope for the mailbox's mode — mail.test:send or mail.agent:send; the matching :write scope does NOT grant sending.

400.description: Validation, send quota reached, or outbound not configured.

401.description: Missing/invalid auth or token lacks mail.test:send / mail.agent:send.

x-codeSamples.label: curl
x-codeSamples.source:
curl -X POST "https://login.ollastack.com/api/mailboxes/<mailboxId>/send" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"to":"human@example.com","subject":"Your weekly agent report","text":"All systems nominal."}'

post.summary: Reply to a received message
post.description: Recipient defaults to the original sender; subject gets Re:; In-Reply-To/References keep the thread intact in real mail clients. Requires mail.test:send / mail.agent:send.

example.text: Thanks — handled. Let me know if anything else comes up.

400.description: Validation, replying to an outbound message, or quota.

x-codeSamples.label: curl
x-codeSamples.source:
curl -X POST "https://login.ollastack.com/api/mailboxes/<mailboxId>/messages/<messageId>/reply" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"text":"Thanks — handled. Let me know if anything else comes up."}'

get.description: Recent mail.received webhook push attempts for this mailbox (newest first) so you can see whether your endpoint is receiving the signed pushes. Delivery is fire-and-forget (no retries) — for guaranteed capture, poll /wait.
This month's received/sent counts vs your plan ceilings, plus the agent/test/BYO domains your mailboxes use. Call this to render meters or to learn agentDomain before creating an agent mailbox.

401.description: Missing/invalid auth or token lacks mail.test:read / mail.agent:read.

get.description: Rules run best-effort right after an inbound message is stored (hard spam excluded): when a received message matches the conditions, the actions fire (mark read / AI-enrich / auto-reply / forward / webhook / notify-email).

post.summary: Create a workflow rule on a mailbox
post.description: conditions: {field, op, value} — field is one of from|subject|body|to|_spam; op is contains|not_contains|equals|not_equals|exists. actions: {type:'mark_read'} | {type:'enrich'} | {type:'auto_reply', body} | {type:'forward', to} (send onward from the mailbox identity; uses send quota) | {type:'webhook', url} (POST a lean summary, SSRF-guarded) | {type:'notify_email', to, subject?} (platform alert to a fixed inbox). matchType 'all' (default) requires every condition; 'any' requires one.

actions.body: Thanks — your invoice is attached shortly.

x-codeSamples.label: curl
x-codeSamples.source:
curl -X POST "https://login.ollastack.com/api/mailboxes/<mailboxId>/rules" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"name":"Auto-reply to invoice requests","matchType":"all","conditions":[{"field":"subject","op":"contains","value":"invoice"}],"actions":[{"type":"auto_reply","body":"Thanks — your invoice is attached shortly."}]}'

schema.description: Any subset of {name, enabled, matchType, conditions, actions, sortOrder}.

bearerAuth.description: Personal API token issued from the dashboard. Shown once on creation; pass as `Authorization: Bearer <your-token>`.

sessionCookie.name: ollastack_session
sessionCookie.description: Browser session cookie set by /api/auth/login. Agents should use bearerAuth instead.

code.description: Machine-readable error code. Agents key on this.

retryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before retry, when code=RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.

id.description: Field name in the submissions payload.

type.description: Input type. The builder enforces a strict enum; creation is permissive.

id.description: Field name in the submissions payload.

options.description: Choices for select/radio. Objects, not bare strings.

allowedOrigins.description: Public submit POSTs from other origins are 403'd unless empty array.

projectId.description: File the new form under this project (must be in the form's org).

UpdateForm.description: Every form setting except the field list. All properties are optional — only the supplied ones change. To define form FIELDS use PATCH /api/forms/{formId}/builder instead; schemaJson is rejected here. One PATCH can set any combination of these.

projectId.description: File (or null to unfile) the form under a project in its org.

emailEnabled.description: Master switch for submission notification emails.

emailSubjectTemplate.description: Supports {{form_name}} and any field id, e.g. {{name}}.

notificationTemplateHtml.description: Custom notification email HTML. {{field}} placeholders supported.

retentionDays.description: Auto-delete submissions after N days. 0 / null = keep forever.

maxFileSizeBytes.description: Per-file size cap in BYTES (e.g. 25 MB = 26214400).

captchaRequired.description: Enforce CAPTCHA. Needs a platform CAPTCHA provider configured to take effect.

allowedOrigins.description: Browser Origin allowlist. Empty = any origin. JSON array, not a comma string.

autoresponderEnabled.description: Needs the submission payload to carry _replyto or an email field.

customCss.description: CSS for the hosted form page.

submittedVia.description: Provenance label. Identifies whether a submission came from an anonymous caller or an authenticated agent. Useful for filtering the inbox.

submittedByTokenId.description: Opaque identifier of the agent that submitted this entry, if any.

SubmitPayload.description: Any JSON payload. Field keys not prefixed with `_` map to form fields. Reserved magic fields: `_replyto` (sets Reply-To header), `_subject` (overrides email subject), `_next` (post-submit redirect URL — must match form.allowedOrigins or successRedirectUrl), `_gotcha` (honeypot — bots fill, humans don't).

prefix.description: First 8 chars of the plaintext token (for identification).

agentType.description: Whether this token is held by a human or an authorized AI agent. Agent submissions go through cleanly while bots stay blocked.

scopes.description: Defaults to [forms:read, forms:write] if omitted. Scopes are enforced — a token can only call routes its scopes permit. Mail scopes are split by function and never granted by default: mail.test:{read,write,send} = disposable test inboxes (Mail Testing); mail.agent:{read,write,send} = persistent agent identities (Agent Mail). A token scoped to one mode cannot touch the other. The mode-blind mail:{read,write,send} are DEPRECATED but still accepted (they span both modes).

expiresInDays.description: Token lifetime in days from creation. Omit for a non-expiring token.

url.description: Must be https (or http for ALLOW_PRIVATE_WEBHOOKS=true in dev only).

secret.description: Optional HMAC-SHA256 signing secret. If set, every delivery includes X-Ollastack-Signature: sha256=<hex>.

events.description: Events to subscribe to. Omit for the default set. NOTE: the request field is `events`; the Webhook object echoes it back as `subscribedEvents`.

Mailbox.description: A logical email-testing inbox. Mail sent to `address` (including `+tag` variants, e.g. slug+ci-run-42@domain) is captured, parsed, and exposed via the messages API.

slug.description: Address local-part. Random for test mode; the user-chosen handle for agent mode. Never reused on its domain.

mode.description: agent = persistent inbox with a chosen identity (spam-filtered); test = disposable CI inbox (unfiltered).

domain.description: Receiving domain (agent / test subdomain, or a verified BYO domain).

retentionDays.description: Messages older than this are deleted + PII-purged by the retention cron.

lastIngestAt.description: Last time the relay delivered mail here — the dead-relay signal.

MailMessage.description: A received email. `codes` and `links` are extracted at ingest — `codes[0]` is typically the OTP your test is waiting for.

truncated.description: True if a body exceeded 1MB and was cut.

attachments.description: Attachment metadata. Inbound attachment bytes (≤10 MB) are stored when object storage is configured — fetch them via GET .../attachments/{index} (0-based) for a short-lived download URL.

codes.description: OTP/verification codes extracted from the body, best match first.

direction.description: inbound = received by the mailbox; outbound = sent from it.

deliveryStatus.description: Outbound only. 'scheduled' = queued for a future sendAt (see scheduledAt); 'sending' = claimed by the drain; then 'sent'/'failed'.

scheduledAt.description: When a scheduled send will be delivered (set only while deliveryStatus=scheduled).

isSpam.description: Agent inboxes only: hard spam. Excluded from the normal list, /wait, unread, and webhooks; visible via ?spam=true.

spamReason.description: Spam verdict detail. `quarantine:*` means delivered-but-flagged (ML-alone); other values accompany isSpam=true.

MailAttachmentUpload.description: One outbound attachment. Total across attachments ≤ 10 MB.

text.description: Plain-text body. text and/or html required.

attachments.description: Optional file attachments, ≤10 MB total. Not allowed with sendAt.

sendAt.description: Optional ISO-8601 future time (≤90 days). When set, the message is queued (deliveryStatus=scheduled) and delivered by the drain on/after that time — use for reminders/follow-ups. Cannot be combined with attachments.

MailIngestFailure.description: Mail that arrived for this mailbox but was NOT stored (quota, rate limit, parse error, oversize) — the lost-mail audit trail.

mode.description: agent = persistent inbox with a chosen identity (spam-filtered); test = disposable random CI inbox.

handle.description: Required for agent mode: the chosen address local-part (letters, numbers, dots, dashes). Globally unique per domain.

domain.description: Optional agent-mode BYO domain (paid). Must match the org's verified custom sender domain; defaults to the platform agent domain.

retentionDays.description: Capped by plan (free 3, solo 30, team 90). Default min(30, plan max).

orgId.description: File the mailbox under a specific org you belong to (also sets the plan cap). Omitted => your default org. 403 if you're not a non-viewer member of it.

isActive.description: false pauses ingest (mail goes to failures).

webhookUrl.description: Agent-mail push: signed POST (X-Mail-Signature: v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of the body with the mailbox's webhookSecret>) on every received message. https-only, private IPs rejected. null clears it.

projectId.description: File this AGENT mailbox under a project in its org (null = unfile). Test inboxes can't be filed.

autoEnrich.description: Auto-run AI triage on every inbound message (stored on the message). Requires AI enabled on the server.

webhookIncludePayload.description: Inbound Parse: when true, the webhook body carries the FULL parsed message (see MailWebhookEvent) so you get structured JSON in one hop. Default false sends a lean nudge (ids + codes + links only) and you fetch the body via GET /api/mailboxes/{id}/messages/{id} — safer if the webhook URL could leak.

MailWebhookEvent.description: Body POSTed to a mailbox's webhookUrl on each received message. Signed: X-Mail-Signature: v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256(body, webhookSecret)> — verify it before trusting the payload. The message fields after `receivedAt` are present ONLY when the mailbox has webhookIncludePayload=true.

truncated.description: Full payload only: a body was over 1MB and clipped.

attachments.description: Full payload only: metadata only ({filename, mimeType, sizeBytes}); bodies are not stored in v1.

spamReason.description: Full payload only: set when ML-quarantined.

MailUsage.description: This month's mail usage vs your plan ceilings, plus the per-mode domains.

agentDomain.description: Domain for agent inboxes (null if agent mail is off).

byoDomain.description: Your verified custom domain, if any (paid).

MailWebhookDelivery.description: One mail.received webhook push attempt (delivery-health log).

status.description: sent = 2xx; failed = non-2xx or network error.
